# About Me

I am Nicholas Nazak, a PhD student at Case Western Reserve University studying Biomedical Engineering. My current research entails leveraging wearable devices to aid in stroke rehabilitation with [Dr. Chris Pulliam](https://case.edu/bme/people/primary-faculty/christopher-pulliam). 

# Education
B.S. in Biomedical Engineering, Case Western Reserve University, Cleveland, Ohio (2022)

# Professional Experience
Project Manager at [Rahm Sensor Development, Inc.](https://www.rahmsd.com/) (Current)

Operations Manager at [VetGuardian](https://zom-dx.zomedica.com/Products/vetguardian/) (2020 - 2023)
